arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
for name in ('smoke','empty'):
    raw = open(f'examples/{name}.input.json','rb').read()
    expected = json.load(open(f'examples/{name}.expected.json'))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'project/campaign_cli.py'], input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    got = json.loads(p.stdout)
    print(name, 'rc='+str(p.returncode), 'match='+str(got == expected), 'stderr='+repr(p.stderr.decode()))
PY
cd /workspace/project && find . -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort
